Install linux-omarchy-muqss on Omarchy

The Omarchy Linux (MuQSS CPU scheduler) kernel and modules

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add linux-omarchy-muqss
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 7.2.8-8:
    pacman -Qi linux-omarchy-muqss

Open and use linux-omarchy-muqss

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql linux-omarchy-muqss

Frequently asked questions

How do I install linux-omarchy-muqss on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add linux-omarchy-muqss. The download is 183.1 MB and it takes 183.3 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is linux-omarchy-muqss free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed GPL-2.0-only.

How do I uninstall linux-omarchy-muqss?

Run omarchy pkg drop linux-omarchy-muqss. It removes the package from your system.

What does linux-omarchy-muqss depend on?

The package declares 3 dependencies: coreutils, initramfs, kmod. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is linux-omarchy-muqss in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as linux-omarchy-muqss (version 7.2.8-8) in the official Omarchy package repository. Project site: https://omarchy.org. This site is unofficial and not affiliated with Omarchy or Omacom.
